tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon dkar dmag zor bsangs mchod// oṃ grub par gyur cig 'dir gu ru rin po che padmas srid zhi'i mgron mchod rgya brngan chen mo dang / dpal phyag na rdo rjes mdzad zer ba'i dgra lha dpangs bstod sogs yig snying rnams dang rjes 'brel mkhas grub kha shas nas srid zhi'i mgron mchod bsangs yig gnang 'dug pa rnams na ma 'thus pa cher med mod/ rang rang gi bsams pa dang mthun par sde dge zhu chen rin po che nas kyang bsangs yig lugs mang po gnang 'dug pa des kyang chog mod/ da dung mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dang dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mor sger bsangs dgos lugs byung bas de bzhin smos na/ phud phye gtsang ma chu chang mar gyis sbrus pa'i mgon dkar zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa dang dmag zor lha mor gru gsum smug rtsi can 'khor gtor gru gsum bzhi dang bcas/ mgon po dang lha mo'i gtor ma gnyis thad sha dang mar rgyan sogs ci mdzes zas snas brgyan pa chang gis sbyang / spos kyi bdug phye mar phud chang / mdung dar/ mda' dar/ lhag par mkhan pa sogs bsangs sna gtsang zhim gyi dud pa shin tu che ba rnams so/ /dngos gzhi ni/ thun mtshams kyi lha zhes rang kyai rdor/ 'jigs mdzad mkha' spyod ma sogs kyi bsgoms bzlas byed pa'i thun mtshams spyod lam sar lha snang ma bral bar dgos pa de ga'i mu nas mchod gtor bsangs rdzas de dag la dmigs te/ oṃ las rang bzhin stong par/ āḥlas thod snod yangs par/ hūm̐ las mchod gtor bdud rtsi/ gzhan yang mchod sprin tshogs gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ kyai 'jig rten dbang phyug deng 'dir/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams mgron du/ /dgos 'dod char 'bebs mgon po/ /yid bzhin nor mchog bsangs so/ /chos dbyings shes rab phar phyin/ /rgyal yum gos dkar ro langs/ /'dod khams dbang gi mtshan la sogs/ /ngo mtshar lha mo bsangs so/ /thabs shes rnam gnyis 'khor bcas/

/bsangs mchod dag pa rab 'byams/ /sngon gyi smon lam las byung / /phyi nang gsang bas bsangs so/ /lhag par 'dod dgu lhun grub/ /dri zhim spos dud sprin 'khrigs/ /bza' bca' lhag myang ro drug /phye mar lha yi zhal zas/ /mdung mda' zung 'jug rten can/ /srid 'di'i dkor nor ji snyed/ /zag med bde skyid lha rdzas/ /kun bzang thugs smon bsangs rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul lhag bsam/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs/ /snang grags rig gsum thams cad/ /rang bzhin gsal stong zung 'jug /'dzin med blo 'das bsangs so/ /khyed la phrin las zhu ba/ /thugs dam ji bzhin rjes dran/ /bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen mdzod la/ /'phral yun dge legs kun stsol/ /bye brag bdag cag gzhis byes/ /'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam/ /theg chen spyi dang bye brag /rdo rje theg ltar spyod na/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ /lus dang grib ltar mdzad nas/ /ston bsu phyi nas skyel ma/ /lam 'phrang chu sogs snod dang / /mi dang gcan gzan la sogs/ /gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med/ /gdug can cho 'phrul las byung / /lus nad sems mi bde ba/ /nor gyi god dang kha 'gog /zas min rbad 'dre rbod gtong / /gdug can gno kun skyobs par/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan mo'i/ /mel tshe dam pa mdzod la/ /yo srongs 'gyel slongs chad mthud/ /rjed skul stor 'tshol ral tshems/ /mgo gang yar stod kyus gang / /mar srings legs tshogs brgyar sprod/ /nyes tshogs stong dang bsnol la/ /bsam pa rgya mtsho sgrubs dang / /re ba rgya mtsho skongs sogs/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog cig /spo la dar bzang 'phyar nas/ /khrom du dung yang bus la/ /snyan grags 'jig rten kun khyab/ /mdor na srid zhi'i don kun/ /lhun gyis sgrub cig bsangs so/ /zhes brjod gtor phye phud chang / /gtsang sar phul la rjes ni/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor sogs kyis/

/'phrin bcol bkra shis brjod de/ /mgron po lam bsangs 'di 'dra/ /shar chen kun dga' ye shes/ /dbang phyug mtshan can sde bzhi/ /dge bcu 'dzom pa'i yul grur/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen byon tshe/ /thugs bzhed ji bzhin sa rgan kha bdar kun blor bskur// //de 'phral phul lo shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mgon dkar dmag zor bsangs mchod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
